approach-narrow-the-claim-instead.reason: It makes the document honest and the gate no better. The two workspaces left out are the delivery binding and the collector ingress — authentication, deduplication, retry, backpressure. A required static-analysis context that deliberately declines to look at those is a gate in name; correcting the sentence would record that choice rather than make it.

forces: `openspec/scripts/` and `.github/scripts/` have no coverage report at all, so analysing them under a new-code coverage condition would fail the next PR that edits the governance checker or the merge gate.
approach-add-every-tree-including-reposi.reason: It would fail the next pull request that edits the governance checker. Neither `openspec/scripts/` nor `.github/scripts/` produces a coverage report, and the gate's `new_coverage` condition is evaluated on new code, so a touched line in an analysed file with no coverage reports zero and reds a required context. Closing the whole gap in one change trades a silent omission for a blocked repository.

forces: An explicit list with no completeness assertion has already failed twice in this repository, in the `make` recipes (#412) and in their notices (#441).
approach-correct-the-lists-without-asser.reason: It is exactly what produced this defect. The list was correct when written and went stale when a workspace was added, and the same is true of the `make` recipes and their notices — both of which needed an assertion, not a correction, before they stopped drifting. A third correction with no assertion behind it predicts a fourth.

security_justification.trust_boundary: The required static-analysis gate sits inside the boundary that admits code to the protected mainline. This change widens what that gate inspects to include the authentication, deduplication, retry and backpressure paths, and adds an assertion so the scope cannot silently narrow again.
security_justification.authority_provenance: No actor, tenant, or authority value is read, derived, or emitted. The change alters which paths an analyser indexes and adds one repository-script assertion; neither participates in event authority.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: No authentication or authorization decision changes. The analyser token, host and project key are untouched, and no permission block is modified.
security_justification.audit_integrity: No audit event, catalog entry, or emitted record changes. The gate's own record improves: its scope becomes a checked claim rather than a header comment asserting a completeness it did not have.
security_justification.confidentiality: No data is read, stored, or transmitted that was not already. The added paths are source already present in the repository, and no new secret or endpoint is introduced.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Every written path is governance_core or the fold target, and each is owned here by an explicit inventory. No path outside that inventory is written.
security_justification.fail_posture: Fail-closed in both directions. A declared package absent from the scope fails, and a scope entry under no declared package fails. No existing failing arm is removed and no threshold is relaxed; the gate's three conditions are untouched.
security_justification.error_disclosure: Diagnostics name the workspace or the stray path only, matching the existing package-discovery diagnostic shape. No file contents, environment, or credential material is included.
security_justification.concurrency: No concurrency is introduced, removed, or reordered. The assertion is one synchronous read of one properties file, and the analyser's own parallelism is unchanged.
security_justification.lifecycle: No lifecycle state, transition, or ordering changes. The assertion runs where package discovery already runs, and no OpenSpec lifecycle rule is altered.
security_justification.resource_retention: Nothing is retained. The assertion holds the properties file for one synchronous read and adds no cache, queue, or store.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: No retry or redelivery path changes. The sonar job's existing bounded scan and download retries are untouched.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptographic material, algorithm, signature, or hash chain is introduced, read, or changed.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No field transformation, redaction, or privacy policy is involved, and no personal or tenant data is in scope.
security_justification.external_security_integration: SonarQube is an existing required gate and remains one on the same project key and quality profile. Nothing is integrated; the scope of an existing integration widens to the packages it already claimed to cover.
